title: Integer quantization postulate for a frequency-loop integral
description: The assignment of an integer value to a dimensionless frequency-loop integral is recorded as a symbolic model postulate. It does not follow from dimensional analysis alone and is not presented as experimentally established.
definitions: Omega is the dimensionless cycle count for a specified integration domain.
n is an integer-valued model label.
assumptions: Integer-valued Omega is imposed as an additional symbolic model rule.
The frequency f is ordinary frequency in hertz and t is physical time in seconds.
mechanism: Symbolic integer-quantization postulate applied to a dimensionless cycle count; no quantization mechanism or empirical evidence is asserted.
falsification_conditions: A declared model domain admits a valid Omega value outside the integers while claiming the integer postulate applies throughout that domain.
confusion_guard: Omega = n is a SYM postulate, not a consequence of Omega being dimensionless and not an experimentally established law.
